capabilities: Run configurable timed writing sprints (25 minutes by default)
Track daily and overall word count goals
Nudge the writer after 10 or 60 seconds of inactivity
Record sprint stats such as words per minute, words added, deleted, and net
Export all stats to a CSV file in the vault
extras: Can be installed via the Obsidian42 - BRAT beta plugin loader; the author accepts donations via buy-me-a-coffee.
motivation: Inspired by a discussion in the Discord creative channel during NaNoWriMo 2021.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run timed writing sessions with idle nudges and word-count tracking for writing projects.
summary: Timed writing-sprint timer that tracks word count goals, nudges idle writers, and records per-sprint statistics.
